nclskins.mojang_account_ownership.name: Common Minecraft Capes
nclskins.mojang_account_ownership.descri: Permanent Java account rewards granted for owning, migrating, or signing in to Minecraft.
nclskins.mojang_account_ownership.author: Mojang Studios
nclskins.mojang_account_ownership.cape.p: Granted automatically to every Java Edition owner since May 8, 2025.
nclskins.mojang_account_ownership.cape.m: Granted to eligible players who migrated a Mojang account to a Microsoft account.
nclskins.mojang_account_ownership.cape.v: Granted to players who owned both Java Edition and Bedrock Edition for PC before the editions were bundled.
nclskins.mojang_account_ownership.cape.c: Granted for signing in to Bedrock Edition with a Microsoft account during its limited promotion and made available in Java Edition.
nclskins.mojang_account_events.name: Minecraft Events and Promotions
nclskins.mojang_account_events.descripti: Permanent Java account rewards earned through public Minecraft events and promotions.
nclskins.mojang_account_events.cape.mine: Granted to MINECON 2011 attendees after its design was chosen by a public community vote.
Granted to MINECON 2012 attendees using the design that placed second in the 2011 community vote.
Rewarded for completing Minecraft Experience: Villager Rescue.
nclskins.mojang_account_events.cape.moon: Rewarded for completing Minecraft Experience: Moonlight Trail; Java Edition distribution began in May 2026.
nclskins.mojang_account_events.cape.craf: Rewarded for completing activities at TwitchCon Rotterdam in May 2026.
nclskins.mojang_account_events.cape.foun: Released for MINECON Live 2019 in Bedrock Edition and granted to eligible Java Edition owners in 2025.
nclskins.mojang_account_events.cape.cher: Rewarded to players who participated in Mob Vote 2023.
nclskins.mojang_account_events.cape.foll: Rewarded through the TikTok promotion celebrating Minecraft's 15th anniversary.
nclskins.mojang_account_events.cape.purp: Rewarded for watching eligible Minecraft streams on Twitch during the 15th anniversary celebration.
nclskins.mojang_account_events.cape.anni: Free anniversary reward offered through Minecraft.net in 2024 for Minecraft's 15th anniversary.
nclskins.mojang_account_events.cape.mcc_: Rewarded for completing 15 challenges in the MCC x Minecraft event celebrating Minecraft's 15th anniversary.
nclskins.mojang_account_events.cape.moja: Rewarded for completing five daily challenges during the Eerie Mojang Office Party.
nclskins.mojang_account_events.cape.home: Rewarded through the Twitch promotion connected to A Minecraft Movie.
nclskins.mojang_account_events.cape.mena: Rewarded through the TikTok promotion connected to A Minecraft Movie.
nclskins.mojang_account_events.cape.year: Rewarded for completing challenges in the A Minecraft Movie event; its name references the character's yearning for the mines.
nclskins.mojang_account_events.cape.copp: Rewarded during the Copper Cape Quest held in October 2025.
nclskins.mojang_account_events.cape.zomb: Rewarded during Spear Mayhem for defeating five mobs with a spear in Bedrock Edition Survival.
nclskins.mojang_account_events.cape.buil: Rewarded for watching eligible Twitch or TikTok streams in 2026.
nclskins.mojang_global_events.name: Temporary Minecraft Capes
nclskins.mojang_global_events.descriptio: One-off capes shown to every player during global celebrations without being added to accounts.
nclskins.mojang_global_events.cape.chris: Displayed temporarily on every player on December 24-25, 2010, without being added to accounts.
nclskins.mojang_global_events.cape.new_y: Displayed temporarily on every player on December 31, 2010, without being added to accounts.
nclskins.mojang_global_events.cape.scrol: Displayed temporarily on every player on December 11-12, 2014, to celebrate the release of Scrolls; the same texture also existed as a selective competition award.
